com.invoiceparserpro/capability.category: Cached accounting data and posting rules
com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Choose an active posting account from the saved chart for one invoice. May update learned vendor coding; manual vendor rules stay unchanged. Creates no bill or payment. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: List the active cached posting accounts for the connected provider. Preview coding the invoice we selected to the account I choose, explain any learned-rule effect, and wait for confirmation.

annotations.title: Preview: Select an invoice posting account

description: Prepare choosing an active account from this workspace's cached chart. Supplier and account names come from saved records. Reuses review coding: manual vendor rules stay unchanged; otherwise its learned vendor rule/counter is updated. No provider refresh, bill push or payment. Requires confirmation. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
